scope: Retained LAMMPS protocols, primary output and numerical post-processing; no new MD run

static_pair.boundary_condition: External coordinate springs, K = 20 eV/A^2, with spring energy included in minimisation

profile_correction.issue: A fixed historical cutoff at z = 40.24 A excluded the nearest pure matrix layer
profile_correction.correction: Use the maximum height over all inclusion IDs in both snapshots, including Al and Fe
profile_correction.signed_md_convention: Positive normal compression; opposite to tensile-positive Cauchy stress

interface_loading.element_mapping: 1 Al, 2 Fe, 3 Mg, 4 Si; only Al and Fe populated
interface_loading.applied_force_conversion: tau_MPa * 10 * Lx_A * Ly_A * 6.241509e-7 / N_top, eV/A per driven atom
interface_loading.interpretation: Adjacent sampling intervals in single trajectories; early motion and seam fragments prevent a material-threshold or null-effect claim

alloy_comparator.stress_change_note: Conservative rounded bound; exact per-rung values in stageG6_stress_selection_relA.json
alloy_comparator.initial_state_provenance: IDs, types and fixed-bottom coordinates agree, but the later-saved initial file has no launch-time hash verifying mobile coordinates

remaining_limits: No independent size, loading-rate, seed, force-tolerance or spring-stiffness convergence study
The MEAM parameter mapping is checked; quantitative transferability to this interface is not independently validated
Prescribed strain is an assumed mechanical input, not a measured magnetic response
Short DXA fragments do not establish nucleation or a reaction pathway
Passing regression tests verifies the implemented analysis, not the underlying physical model
